description: Danish Datacenters is a community-maintained CSV inventory of data-centre facilities in Denmark. The repository documents 88 entries and links a column dictionary and public planning-document index. Fields describe facility identity, city or market, address, operator, operating status, IT power in MW, floor areas, redundancy arrangements and connectivity characteristics. The data can distinguish operational, under-construction, planned and decommissioned facilities. Geographic coverage is Denmark at facility level; a complete observation interval or fixed refresh frequency is not stated. The public CSV is free to access, and the repository states CC BY 4.0 for its data. Data Center Map is identified as its main source, whose underlying terms were not independently checked during this review. A limitation is that a documented field does not establish that every facility supplies that value, and unknown entries must not be interpreted as zero. Simulation uses include mapping facility demand and testing regional capacity or outage scenarios. It relates to data-data-center-map-directory as a documented upstream source, while this separately published CSV has its own schema and community planning-document collection. No facility rows or planning attachments were downloaded.
